info.title: TV Dashboard Custom GPT Actions
info.description: Compact OAuth façade over tv-dashboard-api (VISTA). Owner of catalog and writes remains TV. Legacy gpt_* Actions under GOVERNED_PREPARE_COMMIT_V2 coexist with the vista_* semantic verbs (SEMANTIC_TOOLS_V1); openapi.json is import-only and not listed here.

post.description: Specialist context: assistant identity, principal type, effectiveCapabilities (derived from real AuthZ — catalog informs, never grants), confirmation model, catalogVersion. action=catalog returns the full canonical catalog.

READ by closed entity+action: playlist.list|get|context, playlist_history.history, data_route.search, data_model.inspect, product_guide.guide. BlockIndex/DataSources coverage. Unknown entity/action -> errors.

ref.description: Entity id: playlistId for playlist.get/context and playlist_history.history; modelId for data_model.inspect; topic for product_guide.guide.

filters.description: Declared filter keys only per action (e.g. slideId, scope, snapshotId, page, query, playlistId, topic, section). Undeclared keys are rejected.

post.description: Owner analyses that never persist: data_block_preview, data_model_preview, intent_materialization (NL intent → typed ops candidates for the governed envelope). Response carries evidenceClass (preview|calculation).

subjectRefs.description: Authoritative refs: playlistId, slideId, blockId, modelId, hostContext fields.

parameters.description: Per-analysis params (operationId/params for data_block_preview; model/nativeConfig for data_model_preview; message for intent_materialization).

post.description: Product guide registry (GUIDANCE_NOT_DOMAIN_TRUTH). action=get: one guide by topic (+optional section); omit topic for the index. action=search: bounded deterministic index projection filtered by query.

Governed mutation facade (entity=presentation, action=apply_mutation). phase=prepare: operations[] + target → sealed proposal_handle (+consentChallenge when confirm). phase=commit: proposal_handle + idempotency + consent_artifact + target_echo. Never re-send operations[] at commit (PLAN_MISMATCH).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required for phase=commit (or commit_now) — or use body idempotency_key. Atomic acquire before write; same key+payload replays.

operations.description: Typed presentation ops from the canonical TV catalog (objects with op — never bare strings). Shape projected from PresentationOpsContentService.

Preview executes the candidate model and validates consumer fields before any write.

primaryDataSourceId.description: Legacy data_source block id that hosts the final transform.

relatedDataSourceIds.description: Optional explicit sibling source ids embedded as extra model inputs. When omitted, the backend derives them from the primary transform merge.sourceId dependency closure.

modelLabel.description: Optional user-facing DataModel label; defaults to the primary source binding label.

targetModelId.description: Optional explicit model id; omit to generate mdl_*.

removeOrphanedSources.description: When true, migrated legacy source blocks are removed only if nothing still consumes them (no visual/cell binding and no legacy merge dependency outside the migrated set). Sibling sources with direct consumers are always retained.

oneOf.description: Typed minimal patch over an EXISTING DataModel: the backend rebuilds the full candidate from the persisted model — omitted fields are preserved (never resend untouched inputs/transforms). inputPatches[].params uses the same set/unset/ExpressionSpec contract as patch_data_source_params; inputPatches[].transform and modelPatch.transform are TransformPlan v1 {version, steps} applied only when the key is present (null clears). modelPatch.fieldLabels merges over persisted labels (null clears). Resulting model is normalized and re-validated against consumers before PREPARE.

modelId.description: Persisted DataModel id — discover via get_playlist_context dataModels[]/blockIndex[].modelId/focusedBinding or inspect_data_model. Never inferred from labels/fields/blockIds.

inputPatches.description: Patches por input existente; inputId desconhecido falha. Campo omitido = preservado.

params.description: Same set/unset semantics as patch_data_source_params (literal scalars or canonical ParamExpression spec; null/empty in set = unset).

transform.description: TransformPlan v1 {version, steps} for this input only; applied only when key present; null clears the input transform.

createIfMissing.description: Quando true, permite criar bloco com id novo/ausente. Padrão seguro: false para text/heading/shape sem frame.

block.description: Smallest semantic block accepted by TvPresentationPatchV1 upsert_block. No resolved/url/mScript. Extra known editor keys may be present and are merged.

textProjection.description: Bind live field onto heading|text|shape: {field, format|displayFormat, aggregation?, prefix?, suffix?, fallback?}. Field must come from data preview/paramSchema.

style.description: Optional visual style. For shapes/cards prefer fill+stroke+strokeWidth+borderRadius+boxShadow combo from designTokens.shapeChrome.

kpiProjection.description: KPI field binding. Prefer metrics[].format|displayFormat (number|percent|currency|raw). Never leave empty after bind_visual.

chartOptions.description: ChartStyleOptions: legend, grid, labels, axes, stackMode, sort, topN, density and valueFormat. No free CSS.

chartProjection.description: Chart axes/series binding — do not leave empty after bind_visual.

tableOptions.description: Table presentation knobs (fonts, header, density). Free-form editor blob; prefer set_table_options when available.

dataTransform.description: Prefer set_data_transform; if present must be a TransformPlan ({steps}).

proposal_handle.description: phase=commit: exact opaque handle from prepare — binds the sealed plan.

consent_artifact.description: phase=commit on confirm plans: consent challenge id approved by the human via the trusted channel. No boolean substitute exists on this surface.

target_echo.description: phase=commit on confirm plans: exact consentChallenge.targetRef — target identity check, never consent proof.

commit_now.description: Actions-only: phase=prepare commits inline when every op policy is direct. Ignored for confirm plans.

post.description: Destructive ops only (entity in block|section|slide). phase=prepare: entity + target -> sealed proposal_handle + consentChallenge. phase=commit: proposal_handle + idempotency_key + consent_artifact + target_echo. Only the artifact proves consent.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required for phase=commit — or use body idempotency_key.

target.description: playlistId + entity id (slideId|sectionId|blockId); deleteSlides optional for section.

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak access token for the authenticated human actor.

code.description: Machine code e.g. INVALID_CHANGE, AUTHZ_DENIED, NOT_FOUND, PROPOSAL_CHANGED, PROPOSAL_EXPIRED, PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND, CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT, CATALOG_VERSION_STALE, OUTCOME_NOT_VERIFIED, UPSTREAM_FAILURE.

message.description: Human-readable explanation for VISTA to relay.

details.description: Optional diagnostics: operation, opIndex, validationPath, received, expected, internalReason, suggestedCorrection. Never includes tokens, SQL, or stack traces. Intentionally opaque (response-side only).

GptChangeTarget.description: Change target. Omit or leave empty for create_playlist without an existing playlist. playlistId is required by ops that need a playlist.

playlistId.description: Existing playlist UUID when the op requires one.

slideId.description: Slide UUID when the op requires slide context.

GptHostContext.description: Optional editor/host focus. Custom GPT usually omits this; useful when the user already named a playlist/slide in-session.
